ui.chat.interrupt.idle.note: A turn is one agent reply cycle.
ui.chat.interrupt.idle.role: notice after pressing Stop when the agent was not mid-turn
ui.chat.interrupt.idle.tone: one sentence, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.interrupt.idle_disputed.note: Keep the meaning and register of the English; technical tokens in the sentence stay as written.
ui.chat.interrupt.idle_disputed.role: notice after pressing Stop when the runtime says no turn is running but this view showed one
ui.chat.interrupt.idle_disputed.tone: two sentences, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_both.note: Run details is a panel name; /stop is a command and stays literal. A subagent is a helper agent; a background job is a detached command.

placeholders.children: number of running subagents; renders as #
placeholders.jobs: number of background jobs; renders as #

ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_both.role: notice after stopping a turn while subagents and background jobs still run
ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_both.tone: two sentences with a hyphen clause, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_children.note: Run details is a panel name; /stop is a command and stays literal.
ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_children.role: notice after stopping a turn while subagents still run
ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_children.tone: two sentences with a hyphen clause, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_jobs.note: /stop is a command and stays literal. A background job is a detached command that outlives a turn on purpose.
ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_jobs.role: notice after stopping a turn while background jobs still run
ui.chat.interrupt.stopped_jobs.tone: two sentences with a hyphen clause, ends with a full stop

ui.chat.interrupt.unavailable.note: /stop is a command and stays literal.
ui.chat.interrupt.unavailable.role: notice when the backend is too old to stop a single turn
ui.chat.interrupt.unavailable.tone: one sentence with a hyphen clause, ends with a full stop
